description: Acoustic Doppler Velocimeter measurements from Durleigh Reservoir, August 2018 is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environmental Information Data Centre. The dataset contains 5-day of water velocities at Durleigh Reservoir in Somerset, England. A Nortek Vector acoustic doppler velocimeter (ADV) was used to collect the dataset. The ADV was deployed between 20 August 2018 (15:00) and 24 August 2018 (09:15), located approximately 30 m north of the surface mixers in Durleigh reservoir. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Environmental Information Data Centre. Its tags are Durleigh reservoir, Environmental Monitoring Facilities, water velocity. It offers 2 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2026-07-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
